facts.business: Credo Brands Marketing Limited owns and operates MUFTI, a leading Indian lifestyle menswear brand offering casualwear, accessories, and fashion merchandise.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Existence and Valuation of Inventory (Rs. 1,103.54 Million as at March 31, 2026) involving significant management judgment for provisions and risk relating to physical existence and completeness across multiple locations.

key_risks: Inventory valuation involves significant management judgment for provisions at lower of cost and net realisable value
Large volume of inventory items geographically dispersed across multiple locations creates inherent risk relating to physical existence and completeness of inventory records
facts.related_party_note: During the year the Company has not stood guarantee and provided security to any other entity. There are no Subsidiary, Joint ventures and Associates of the company. Aggregate amount granted/provided during the year - Others: Rs. 4.78 Million. Balance Outstanding as at balance sheet date - Others: Rs. 3.40 Million.
